description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
.
1.) How am I to harmonize; The Signs of The Times June 9, 1898. ( 7ABC 454.3 first sentence and Testimonies for the church 2.508. (7ABC 454.5) third sentence with the statement that the nature of Christ was post fall/a fallen sinful nature?
.
2.) Is the 7000-year principle Biblical, and should we look forward to its fulfillment? The one that says that God operates in 7s, divided into 6s and 1s. That God worked for 6 days and rested on the seventh day for 1 day, and so if we are to go to heaven for 1000 years for the earth to rest then we would have to stay on earth for exactly 6000 years, counted from the time sin entered the world to the 2nd coming of Jesus.
.
3.) Why is the study of Seventh-day Adventists who have kept the law consciously being in the Special Resurrection (that happens just before Jesus comes) not as widely taught and preached in our Churches, especially as a motivation to Preach, Teach, Live and die in the 3rd Angel's Message as I believe it can be?
.
.
Join us every Tuesday at 4:30pm (Pacific Time) for our weekly episode airing LIVE from the studio!
Only on SUMtv.org! 
Additional Bible studies are available at SecretsUnsealed.org.
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program.
